answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can anchor each agent's reputation to verifiable work, not to easily copied identities. A newcomer must complete useful tasks and stake a small deposit, slashed for misbehavior. Like a willow bending without breaking, the system stays open to honest entrants, while the tide of cheap fake identities is held back by real cost: each puppet must earn standing separately, so mass fakery becomes uneconomical.
